day one of year 11! I studied 4 hours, 19 minutes and 21 seconds! I want to be able to update and get the best possible grades. I'm aiming for all 9s!

update: I've been studying every since day for an average of 3 hours per day! I had a minor setback yesterday but I'm going to perserve and work extra hard!

update: Lately I've been scared of putting in work but that attitude is not going to get me into oxford. We must persevere  onwards!! I'm planning on finishing my coursework in 80 days and my revision in that time period too. Fighting!!

update: I procrastinated and now I only have 71 days left to finish Art coursework. I've got to get an 8+ in Art but I need to aim higher. For full marks! This is the subject I'm scared of most so I need to face it fearlessly. My goal is Oxford Medicine or Mathematics now! Wish me the best!

update: I've started my art coursework and I'm hoping to finish to a high level by this coming week. I have two tests coming up soon so I'm hoping to smash those! I really want all 9s so it will take absolutely everything I've got! I feel like I'm becoming my happy old self again! :)

update: I feel much stronger in taking the initiative to do hard things. I've got a test tomorrow so I've got to start working. I'm hoping to do at least 6 hours and 30 minutes of revision everyday and 1 hour at least of coursework on weekdays! I'm starting to love the pressure.

If you're in a phase when u had to cut bad influence from ur life, whether it was friends, relationships, family
It's natural to feel severe loneliness sometimes, going days without barely speaking to anyone, and YOU'RE NOT ALONE
But i want you to remember, most people don't even get a ''training arc'' 

Whenever i am overwhelmed by my life, i lay down and imagine the life of a soldier, in a war zone, struggling to sleep, PTSD, constant threat of death, only thing keeping him sane and moving is adrenalin, and i wonder, what wouldn't i give up to escape that reality, to just lay down for a bit without the fear of getting killed by a random grenade, not having to see dead bodies around me, 

I know it's cliche, but we often forget that most people are living lives which you wouldn't be able to bear even as a one time nightmare, and being grateful for it brings u calm and peace, and it's fking free. 


My biggest fear isn't building a company, sleeping 4 hours a night, 

I want you to seriously imagine, the scenerio of living in a warzone, knowing that there's literally nothing u can do if 4 armed men showed up at ur house ready to harm ur family in ways i wouldn't even describe here or living as a medival peasent, about to go to sleep, and far in the distance, u see a hoard, an army of probably Genghis Khan, on horses, and you know exactly what's going to happen to u and ur family AND THERE'S NOTHING U CAN DO, NOTHING

Now come back, and look at your life, are u suffering even 1 percent of the horrors i just told u, WHICH ARE ALL TRUE, none are fictional and made up, U are not helpless in your situation, so there's no need to feel bad, victimise or take a bad step. Embrace your existence
